title: Permission-Aware Retrieval with Nested Groups
signature: def search_with_acl(user_id, query, k, index, acls, groups)
hints: First compute every group the user belongs to, including through subgroups. Walk the subgroup graph with a visited set, because group graphs from an IdP can have cycles.
Evaluate each document in a fixed order: no ACL, then deny user, then deny group, then allow user, then allow group, then the default deny. The first rule that matches decides.
Filter before you rank: pass the allowed doc ids to index.search. Searching first and filtering afterwards returns fewer than k results, and restricted chunks pass through your process.
